context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 146 added permission enforcement middleware (require_perm) and sidebar visibility gating. GET /api/rbac/me/permissions returns user's effective permissions + menu_permissions. POST/PUT/DELETE /api/rbac/roles now require create_roles/edit_roles/delete_roles permissions (admin bypasses). Frontend fetches permissions on login and gates sidebar items via SIDEBAR_PERM_MAP. Admin sees 76 buttons, receptionist sees 52 buttons. Note: rate-manager-btn is correctly visible for receptionist because receptionist template includes rates_calendar_view permission.

clarification_on_expected_behavior.rate_manager_btn: Main agent expected this to be hidden for Sarah, but Sarah has rates_calendar_view permission (part of receptionist template), so it's correctly VISIBLE per SIDEBAR_PERM_MAP. If main agent wants to hide rate-manager for receptionists, they need to either: (1) remove rates_calendar_view from receptionist template, or (2) change SIDEBAR_PERM_MAP to use a different permission key.
clarification_on_expected_behavior.shift_scheduler_btn: Correctly HIDDEN for Sarah because she lacks operations_shifts_view permission.
clarification_on_expected_behavior.calendar_btn: The testId is 'sidebar-calendar' not 'calendar-btn' - this item is not gated in SIDEBAR_PERM_MAP so it should be visible by default.
